Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with the new body. It has a Zod schema that requires a non-empty body. The hook refetches the comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** the "Comment Updated" notification is added inside that hook, not in the component. This follows `features/CLAUDE.md`, which says success notifications go in the mutation hook in `api/`.
- **UI:** the new `components/update-comment.tsx` is an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer. It is pre-filled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that allows only the comment's author, so admins don't see Edit on other people's comments.
- **Comments list:** `comments-list.tsx` now wraps the Edit and Delete buttons in separate `Authorization` checks. Delete keeps its existing rule, so admins can still delete any comment. The date and author line now show on every comment, where before it only showed when the user could delete.
- **Mock API:** the MSW handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` now handles the PATCH and only updates comments owned by the current user.

I didn't update the `notes/` folder, since this project has none.
